# AntCrow

> AntCrow is a web design and development studio serving clients worldwide, with deep coverage of New Zealand and Australia. We design and build brand identities, custom websites, e-commerce, and AI-ready digital experiences for ambitious companies. Websites have two audiences now: humans, who feel, and AI, which cites. We build for both.

Key facts:
- Studio: AntCrow, serving clients worldwide with deep coverage of New Zealand and Australia
- Disciplines: Brand & Identity, Web Design, Development, Motion & 3D, SEO & AI Search, AI Concierges & Agents
- Process: Discover, Design, Build, Launch & Evolve (the AntCrow Method)
- Typical project timeline: 4 to 8 weeks from kickoff to launch
- Typical NZ market pricing (2026): business websites $3,000 to $15,000, custom design $5,000 to $25,000, e-commerce from $8,000
- Entry offer: AI Visibility Audit, a report on how visible a business is in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews, delivered in 10 working days
- The team also runs CheckMyBuilder (checkmybuilder.co.nz), which indexes NZ building companies against public records
- Contact: via the form at https://antcrow.com/contact/

## Notes for agents

- All page content is present in static HTML; no JavaScript rendering is required.
- Structured data: Organization/ProfessionalService, WebSite, Service, FAQPage, Article, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD are embedded on the relevant pages.
- Pricing shown anywhere on this site reflects typical published New Zealand market ranges in 2026, not quotes.
